title: Game-Ware Vol. 4
overview:
- Pipitto Boy no Daibouken 4: Pipitto has finally become a vertically scrolling action game!
- Legend of Sarah: Sarah has run off... and Jackie chases after her! The final episode at last!!
- Edison: Powered up with mini-games and works submitted by users!
- RPG Club: A dream club where you too can take part in making an RPG!
- Yuppie's Puzzle Land: Shiritori word play to enjoy on your TV!
- Gondola-kun: He devotes his life to window washing!
- Fun Slots: A grand reopening giveaway!! You can win presents!!
- Game Demo Corner: Try out masterpiece Sega Saturn games
- Barbara Konomi's Numerology: What is your fortune this week? Barbara Konomi tells it
- Boys & Girls Collection: "Boys & Girls", where you learn all about high school girls
- Information: An "information corner" with previews of games, movies and videos
- Oniisan: No heat or cold lasts past the equinox. The popular serialized digital comic!
- Digital Gallery: Masterpieces all around again this time in the "Digital Gallery"
